Saved Views is available today on all paid plans. You can now save the exact filters, sorting, and grouping you use most, so you no longer have to rebuild the same setup every time you open a project. This makes it faster to check in on a sprint, track priority tasks, or follow work assigned to a specific teammate.

Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you room to organize configurations across different projects, clients, or workflows. Views can also be shared with your team, so a setup you build once can keep everyone looking at the same information during standups, planning sessions, or reviews with stakeholders.

Because Saved Views is included in every paid plan, there's nothing extra to purchase or configure to start using it. It works across every list in your workspace, and it's ready for you to try right now.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
